note: Catalog shortlist of the recognition spike. Fixed-path resistance machines and cardio machines only (D-45). Each type has a distinguishing detail, so a quick owner confirmation stays meaningful (section 6.7 of docs/research/platform-cloud-and-ai.md). An image of a machine outside this list has the label none_of_these.

types.name: Leg press, plate-loaded
types.detail: A sled on rails with plate horns, often at 45 degrees.

types.name: Leg press, selectorized
types.detail: A seat and a footplate, with a weight stack and a pin.

types.name: Hack squat
types.detail: Standing on an angled footplate, back against a pad, shoulder pads on top.

types.name: Leg extension
types.detail: Seated, a roller pad in front of the shins.

types.name: Seated leg curl
types.detail: Seated, a roller pad behind the lower legs and a pad over the thighs.

types.name: Lying leg curl
types.detail: Face-down on a bench, a roller pad behind the ankles.

types.name: Hip abduction or adduction
types.detail: Seated, pads at the knees that open or close sideways.

types.name: Calf raise machine
types.detail: A toe block, with shoulder pads or a knee pad.

types.name: Chest press, selectorized
types.detail: Seated, handles at chest height that push forward, a weight stack.

types.name: Chest press, plate-loaded
types.detail: Seated, handles that push forward, plate horns on the arms.

types.name: Shoulder press
types.detail: Seated, handles at shoulder height that push up.

types.name: Pec fly or rear delt
types.detail: Seated, two arms that swing together in front of the chest.

types.name: Lat pulldown
types.detail: Seated, thigh pads, a bar or handles above the head that pull down.

types.name: Seated row machine
types.detail: Seated, a chest pad, handles in front that pull back.

types.name: Assisted pull-up and dip
types.detail: A knee pad or a platform that lifts, pull-up and dip handles on top.

types.name: Smith machine
types.detail: A barbell fixed in vertical rails, with hooks along the rails.

types.name: Biceps curl machine
types.detail: Seated, the upper arms on an angled pad, handles that curl up.

types.name: Triceps extension or dip machine
types.detail: Seated, handles that push down or out with the elbows bent.

types.name: Back extension machine
types.detail: Seated, a pad behind the upper back that pushes back.

types.name: Abdominal crunch machine
types.detail: Seated, pads or handles at the chest or shoulders that pull forward and down.

types.name: Treadmill
types.detail: A moving belt with a console and hand rails.

types.name: Upright stationary bike
types.detail: A saddle above the pedals, handlebars in front.

types.name: Recumbent stationary bike
types.detail: A seat with a backrest, pedals in front of the seat.

types.name: Rowing machine
types.detail: A sliding seat on a rail, a handle on a chain or a strap, a flywheel.

types.name: Elliptical trainer
types.detail: Two foot pedals on an oval path, often with moving arms.

types.name: Stair climber or stepper
types.detail: Moving steps or two step pedals, with hand rails.
